person.label: Waiting for your confirmation
person.asker.unknown: Daoris could not name what sent it.
person.until: It waits until {{time}}, then is refused.
person.cannotTell: Daoris cannot tell whether you ran this or an agent did. Confirm only what you ran.
person.gone: This no longer waits: it was answered in another window, its two minutes passed, or its terminal took it back.
person.adopted: Daoris is using a service it did not start, so your own acts (a review, a yes, an answer) are refused there. Close what started it and restart Daoris.
person.route.SESSION_ARCHIVE: archive sessions on this machine, or bring them back
person.route.RESOLVE_SESSION: finish or decline a parked session
person.route.SESSION_INPUT: say words to a session as yours
person.route.SESSION_QUEUE_EDIT: take back or reword words waiting on a session
person.route.SESSION_GO_ON_NEW: carry a session's waiting words on in a new session
person.route.SESSION_START_FROM: start a conversation with the words a session could not go on with
person.route.SESSION_HAND_OVER: hand a conversation over to another agent
person.route.SESSION_HELPER_ASK: ask another agent to help a session
person.route.SESSION_HELPER_APPROVE: say yes to an agent's ask for a helper
person.route.SESSION_HELPER_DECLINE: say no to an agent's ask for a helper
person.route.LAND_SESSION_TREE: accept a session's work and land it
person.route.TREES_SYNC: bring the repositories' branches up to date
